away.summary: The Ottawa Senators are coming off a 1-0-0 start to the season. Jake Sanderson is returning to the lineup after missing part of training camp due to an undisclosed injury. Linus Ullmark is confirmed to start in goal, while several key players are injured or out for the game.

home.summary: The Boston Bruins are coming off a 2-1-0 start to the season. Jeremy Swayman is confirmed to start in goal, while Charlie McAvoy is serving the fourth of a six-game suspension for a slashing incident. The team is in good form, with recent wins and a strong showing in their latest game.
